title: MicroLens: Read, Trace, and Rewire the Residual Stream with Two Lenses
abstract: arXiv:2611.13322v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lenses that decode hidden states into words are a popular way to look inside language models, but a heatmap of decoded words only shows what a vector reads as and cannot distinguish whether, or how much, the model uses the information. We present an interactive viewer that puts reading, tracing and editing on the same layers-by-tokens grid of the residual stream. In the viewer, every cell can be decoded with two lenses, the logit lens and the Jacobian lens (J-lens), traced back to the tokens it drew from, and edited, with the rest of the model rerun on the spot. We demonstrate three usage scenarios on Gemma-3-4B-it, backed by sweeps over a few hundred prompts, to show what this tool can discover. First, the two lenses give different directions to write with, each suiting a different edit: the logit lens's word direction sets what a token outputs, while the J-lens's direction changes what later tokens read. translated_title: MicroLens：用两种“透镜”读取、追踪与重连残差流
translated_abstract: 将隐藏状态解码为词语的“透镜”是观察语言模型内部机制的常用方法，但解码词语的热力图只能显示一个向量“读作什么”，无法区分模型是否使用、或在多大程度上使用了该信息。我们提出了一个交互式查看器，将读取、追踪与编辑功能统一到残差流的同一张“层×词元”网格上。在该查看器中，每个单元格都可以用两种透镜解码——logit 透镜和雅可比透镜（J-lens），可以回溯其信息来源词元，并进行编辑，同时模型的其余部分会被当场重新运行。我们在 Gemma-3-4B-it 上演示了三种使用场景，并以数百条提示的批量扫描实验作为支撑，展示该工具能够发现什么。首先，两种透镜提供了不同的“写入”方向，各自适合不同的编辑：logit 透镜的词语方向决定某个词元输出什么，而 J-lens 的方向则改变后续词元读取什么。其次，在两跳知识问答（two-hop trivia）中……
tldr: 本文提出交互式工具 MicroLens，将 logit 透镜与雅可比透镜（J-lens）统一到同一张残差流“层×词元”网格上，实现对隐藏状态的读取、来源追踪与在线编辑，并发现 logit 透镜方向适合控制词元输出、J-lens 方向适合改变后续词元的读取。
en_tdlr: MicroLens is an interactive viewer that unifies reading, tracing, and editing of the residual stream on a single layers-by-tokens grid via the logit lens and the Jacobian lens (J-lens), showing that the logit lens direction best controls what a token outputs while the J-lens direction controls what later tokens read.
